verdict.rationale: Calendly documents round-robin team scheduling and meeting distribution tools, and a community user confirms paying for the Teams plan specifically for Round Robin events. Nothing in the evidence shows weighting, priority, or fairness controls for spreading load across the team. missing for 10: documented weighting/priority settings for round-robin distribution, evidence of load-balancing or fairness controls, in-depth first-party docs on round-robin configuration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, inbound meetings distribute across my team round-robin, with weighting or priority so load stays fair

citations.quote: Standardize scheduling with team templates, admin controls, routing forms, meeting distribution tools, and integrations that fold scheduling into existing workflows.
the only reason we pay for their Teams plan is that 'Round Robin' events are only supported there
